servicesSummary: Commonwealth/Government of The Bahamas During the 6 month reporting period, Brown Rudnick provided legal services to The Commonwealth/Government of the Bahamas ("The Bahamas") in connection with the investigation of and bankruptcy resulting from the collapse of FTX Digital Markets Ltd., which came within the legal representation exemption. Although engaged to potentially provide such services, The Bahamas did not request and Brown Rudnick did not engage in any political activities on behalf of The Bahamas.
